🔥 imgcompress | TypeScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: To provide a private, self-hosted solution for batch image processing, including compression, format conversion, and AI background removal, for users who want to maintain full control over their data and avoid cloud-based services.
✨ Key Features: • Support for over 70 image formats (including PSD, HEIC, RAW, EPS, TIFF, WebP)
📖 Summary: ImgCompress is a self-hosted, Docker-based image processing toolbox that offers a comprehensive suite of tools for compression, format conversion, and AI-powered background removal. It operates entirely locally, ensuring user privacy and data security by processing all files within the user's own container without external uploads.
